scripts.title: Steal Sandwiches
scripts.script:
local ITEM_NAMES = {
    "Sandwich1",
    "Sandwich2",
    "Sandwich3",
    "Sandwich4",
    "Sandwich5"
   }

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local function getHRP()
    local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
    return character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

while task.wait(0.25) do
    local hrp = getHRP()

    for _, itemName in ipairs(ITEM_NAMES) do
        local part = workspace:FindFirstChild(itemName, true)

        if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
            part.CFrame = hrp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 3, 0)
        end
    end
end
scripts.features: Scans the map for sandwiches and brings it to you (Event ends on July 5th)

scripts.title: Steal Items
scripts.features: Steals Items. Hopefully the script doesn't get patched lol. Teleports sandwiches and win tokens to you. (Win token will not work if eliminated). You can get infinite gems by: Afking in a lobby (you can still collect sandwiches when eliminated) and each 1k sandwiches points can be converted into gems at the lobby event shop. Shiny sandwiches (sandwiches that have a yellow aura) give you 30 coins and rarely, gems.
